verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury lets reserve cash sit in an Investment Account earning up to 4.46%, described as "fully automated", alongside a 2% APY Checking Account. Ramp also documents auto top-up with target-balance automation and low-balance alerts, plus "80% of bank transfers automated". The Banking API exposes these accounts and their balance history. However, the yield vehicle is a non-FDIC money-market/fixed-income investment account rather than a savings sub-account. No evidence shows user-defined sweep or transfer rules moving surplus cash into that reserve. Missing for 10: a true savings sub-account, documented user-configurable transfer or sweep rules into the yield account, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
